Recommend improvements in the utilization of personnel, materials, and utilities to enhance operational efficiency. jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description: Sales Coordinator Manila, Philippines | Full-time | Night Shift (aligned to US hours) If you're the kind of person who takes pride in keeping things running smoothly, communicating clearly, and getting things done without being asked twice, this role was written for you. We're looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our Manila team, one of the world's leading branded merchandise companies. You'll work directly alongside global Account Managers, helping deliver merchandise programs for some of the biggest brands in the world. This is a coordination and client support role at its core, and a proven launchpad into a career in sales. Room to Grow Your Career The Sales Coordinator role is a strong foundation for building a career with the client. Coordinators who want to move toward Sales typically progress into an Associate Account Manager role, and from there, into other client-facing or leadership positions within Sales Operations. Progression depends on individual readiness, performance, and business needs, but there's a real, well-supported path for coordinators who want to grow.
